summary: RFC 4412 defines the Resource-Priority Namespaces and Priority-values registries with a management policy of Standards Action. This document updates RFC 4412 to change that policy to IETF Review.

eli5.summary: A club decided that getting a new entry on its list should be a bit easier. This lowers the bar for adding entries to those lists.

questions: ietf review for sip resource priority namespaces
